description: The Canadian building-climate research team publishes weather files for hygrothermal and whole-building simulations under historical and future climates. The public OSF project currently describes twelve Canadian cities, whereas the describing article concerns an earlier eleven-city scope. The registry assigns CC0, allowing free reuse without a licence fee. This resource can supply boundary conditions for heating, cooling, moisture and climate-adaptation simulations. The project is a collection of local climate files, not a national gridded reanalysis, and users need to select the appropriate city, climate period and scenario. The current repository scope is recorded, not assuming that it matches the article exactly. Payloads and compatibility with particular building simulators were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. A limitation is that the present review verifies metadata only.
name: Weather files-building simulations
